create_video_player_stimulus: create a QtStimulus video player with a given duration and video filename
create_video_player_with_position: create a video player stimulus positioned at specific coordinates on screen
create_video_player_from_package: create a video player stimulus loading a video file from a Python package
create_video_player_with_delay: create a video player stimulus that starts playing after a specified delay
create_video_player_random_position: create a video player stimulus with a randomly positioned video on screen
